title: A Crack in the Evidence
paras: When Mara began sorting a box of legal papers, she found a sketch of a cracked measuring jug tucked inside a supply agreement. The papers concerned a workshop that supplied [[glassware|glassware]] to a [[provincial|provincial]] hospital. Together, they [[narrate|narrate]] a dispute between its owner, Tomas Varga, and an inspector who rejected an entire delivery.

The agreement specified Varga's [[contractual|contractual]] obligation to produce vessels of uniform capacity. The inspector's report recorded substantial variations, but letters from hospital physicians [[commend|commend]] Varga's workmanship. Mara initially thought this [[esteem|esteem]] weakened the inspector's case. On rereading the letters, however, she noticed that none referred to the disputed delivery. Praise for earlier work could not establish the quality of this batch.

The record of the [[judicial|judicial]] hearing presented another difficulty. Varga's brief replies suggested [[indifference|indifference]] until Mara reached a clerk's note: an interpreter had repeatedly shortened his explanations. Measurements in the workshop ledger also [[contradict|contradict]] the inspector's figures. Neither document, however, included evidence that the equipment used to measure capacity had been accurately calibrated.

Before opening the final folded sheet, Mara tried to [[envisage|envisage]] an inspection that could distinguish faulty vessels from faulty measuring equipment. She wrote down a proposal to test both sets of equipment against the same reference measure. The court's order was less specific: it required another inspection without assigning blame. Mara placed her proposal beside the order, then searched the remaining papers for the results.
zh: 玛拉开始整理一箱法律文件时，在一份供货协议中发现了一张夹着的带裂痕量杯素描。这些文件涉及一家为地方医院供应玻璃器皿的作坊。它们共同讲述了作坊主人托马斯·瓦尔加与一名检验员之间的纠纷；检验员拒收了整批货物。
协议明确规定，瓦尔加有合同义务生产容量一致的器皿。检验员的报告记录了明显的容量差异，但医院医生的来信却称赞瓦尔加的工艺。玛拉起初认为，这些敬重之辞削弱了检验员的论据。然而，重读信件后，她注意到，没有一封提及有争议的那批货物。对以往工作的赞扬并不能证明这一批货物的质量。
庭审记录带来了另一个难题。瓦尔加简短的回答似乎表明他漠不关心，直到玛拉读到书记员的一条注记：一名口译员曾多次缩短他的解释。作坊账簿中的测量数据也与检验员的数据相矛盾。不过，两份文件都没有提供证据，证明用于测量容量的设备经过了准确校准。
打开最后一张折起的纸之前，玛拉试着设想一种检验方法，以区分究竟是器皿有问题，还是测量设备有问题。她写下一项建议：用同一个标准量器检验双方的设备。法院的命令没有这么具体：它要求重新检验，却没有判定任何一方有责。玛拉把自己的建议放在命令旁边，随后在剩余文件中寻找检验结果。

q.s: Varga's workshop had supplied the hospital for more than ten years before the dispute.
q.why: 首段提及供货关系，未说明持续年限。

q.s: The workshop ledger confirms the inspector's measurements.
q.why: 第三段明确说账簿数据与检验员的数据矛盾。

q.s: The court ordered another inspection without assigning blame.
q.why: 末段明确说明重新检验且未判定责任。
